obstruction.statement: The current primitive language admits a full S6 relabeling symmetry on an allowed symmetric PF-10 local channel state while fixing Cell identities and named P000 axes. Therefore no representation-invariant unique AXIS_HANDLE(x,E_i,h_i) attachment can be derived from the current primitives. Two adjacent symmetric Cells also admit 6! observationally equivalent channel gluings in the absence of a cross-Cell channel transport relation.

minimal_extension.transport_law: same-axis frame incidences induce adjacency/path channel transport; any future native rotation must act equivariantly on both the axis and channel legs
minimal_extension.worst_case_information_lower_bound: five independent axis-channel anchor incidences plus bijectivity; the sixth incidence is forced
minimal_extension.mixed_contact_after_extension: CONTACT_MATCH_b may be read from PF-10 only on Cells where the framed off-diagonal passage pairs E2<->E4 and E3<->E5 actually exist; current PF-10 does not force those passages.
